name: Sweet look in the 1902 universe #1
description: The 1902 universe’s is the beginning of a whole galaxy of Funk Future-Love, where a girl out of this world met a boy and only with her Sweet Eyes, catch his heart between vibrational waves of light and love! Robhin Vargas, creator of Deja Que Suceda ( let it happend ) created this beautiful masterpiece with special care about combination of healing patters of strings, galactic keys and a super energetic bass that dance with the vocals and it’s voice effects! This proyect has 300 editions based in the combination between 3 states, just sit and enjoy! Don’t forget to dance like a galactic kittie and of course, dance it with your loving one . Also available on Spotify and every music platform❤️
